title: M4.2: Teams request verification and ingress
description:
Add Bot Framework JWT validation (issuer, audience, signature against cached OpenID keys, expiry, service URL allowlist) to the hooks ingress, with client secret in SSM SecureString (shell by IaC, value by owner).

Acceptance criteria:
- Invalid or expired tokens are rejected without side effects
- Key rotation of the OpenID document is handled with a bounded cache

Gherkin: features/teams_request_verification.feature

Depends on: M3.2, M4.1

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
